items.text: Astrology and career choice often collide in families where predictions are taken seriously, and the practical approach is to respect the belief, avoid paying for predictions, and make the actual decision using interests, skills, costs, eligibility and small real trials that anyone can check.
Listen to the family, keep decisions grounded in checkable facts and run a small trial so the outcome speaks for itself.
Avoid paying for fear-based remedies and make decisions you can explain.
